title: Fail closed on missing graph linkage before work starts
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Fangore composes a plan that still names a step the host has not wired, and another repeating step without a stop rule. The library must refuse those plans before any runner work starts, naming the missing edge so operators can fix wiring instead of debugging a mid-run crash. Complements `fangore_graph_executor` (authorized run once linkage is sound) and `fangore_convergence_ceiling` (budgets once a loop is allowed). See the inspiration requirements for linkage versus dependency injection and stop contracts[^insp-linkage].
implementation:
`DefaultLinkageResolver` preflight; `CliInstrumentor` verb `graph_linkage_preflight`.

Acceptance walks the registered CLI verb (TestHarnessCliConfig promotes remaining story probes when no src product verb exists yet).
validation: Harness `user_story` walks the promoted product/test verb (no `probe:` wrapper); hard expects on declared observation keys.
